content:
claire: Opening a tiny docs PR to add a short 'on-prem KMS sanity checks' section for the offline installer. Wants an infra + docs review.

omar: drop the PR link when ready. please include a minimal python and curl probe and one-line iptables + nft example for SNAT.

claire: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5177 (draft). Snippets are tiny; main callouts: (1) verify TLS handshake logs during install, (2) test proxy via HTTPS_PROXY, (3) MTU tip for HSMs that use UDP.

claire: curl probe:
```sh
export HTTPS_PROXY='http://10.0.0.9:3128'
curl -sS --proxy "$HTTPS_PROXY" -I https://kms.local/healthz
```

omar: add python requests example and note about verify=/path/to/ca.pem if the distro doesn't use the system store.

claire: python example:
```py
import os, requests
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://10.0.0.9:3128'
print(requests.get('https://kms.local/healthz', verify='/etc/kms/ca.pem', timeout=5).status_code)
```

docs-bot: link-check: no broken links detected in the draft. code fence lint: ok.

ops-oncall: quick note on MTU: if HSM uses CMP/UDP reduce egress MTU to 1400 as a troubleshooting step (`ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400`). Also prefer nft on modern hosts but keep iptables fallback.

claire: adding one-line iptables/nft examples and a one-paragraph 'what to verify after migration' checklist. splitting into two commits: snippets + checks, then link fixes if any. tagging @omar for review. :white_check_mark:
